title: Homological Nielsen realization for the manifolds $\#_n \mathbb{CP}^2$
summary: Given a smooth, oriented, simply-connected $4$-manifold $M$, the homological Nielsen realization problem asks: when does a finite group of isometries $G\leq O(H_2(M;\mathbb{Z}))$ preserving the intersection form lift isomorphically to a finite group of orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms? We study this question for the smooth, positive-definite 4-manifolds $M_n:=\#_n\mathbb{CP}^2$.
